subject: Discovery notes + propose demo/technical sync and evaluation kickoff
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@healix.ai>, Luisa Gomez <luisa.gomez@healix.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery notes + propose demo/technical sync and evaluation kickoff

Hi Samir / Luisa —

Thanks again for the 30-min discovery today. Quick recap from our side and suggested next steps so we can get an evaluation rolling: 

Recap (what we heard)
- Primary goal: reduce triage time for inbound referrals and improve matching to specialty clinicians (target: 20% faster routing).
- Data: EHR export + event streams (HL7 + FHIR) will be accessible; PHI handling required (SOC2 + customer-managed KMS).
- Success metrics you flagged: mean time-to-assign, suggestion precision at top-3, and false-positive rate on urgent flags.

Proposed next steps
1) 60–75 min technical deep dive/demo with your engineering and ops teams — we'll walk runtime constraints, suggested prompt set, and integration options (VPC-private or Dedicated).
2) Evaluation kickoff meeting (trial plan review, success criteria, initial prompt set/eval assets).
3) Share a short draft trial plan and prompt template for you to populate.

Suggested windows (Pacific time) next week:
- Tue 2026-11-10: 10:00–11:15am or 2:00–3:00pm PT
- Wed 2026-11-11: 9:00–10:15am or 3:30–4:30pm PT

I attached a one-page trial plan draft and a prompt-set template to speed prep. If you prefer, we can split into two sessions: a product demo for the broader team and a separate engineering deep dive (we've reserved that option).

If those times work, I'll send calendar invites and include Ben for the deep technical pieces and Marissa for eval success criteria alignment.

Thanks — looking forward.

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments:
- HLX-trial-plan-draft.pdf (1 page)
- prompt-set-template.csv (CSV template, 10 rows)
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@healix.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Luisa Gomez <luisa.gomez@healix.ai>
Date: 2026-11-07T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery notes + propose demo/technical sync and evaluation kickoff

Hi Stephanie —

Appreciate the notes and quick turnaround. Luisa and I reviewed internally; the summary is accurate. A few clarifications before we lock times: 

- Our infra team prefers the engineering deep dive to be the first session so they can validate network/KMS constraints.
- We need to include our compliance lead for a brief SOC2/KMS Q&A (10–15 min) — can she join the tail of the deep dive?
- For success metrics, can we add a throughput requirement (min 200 rps sustained for inference batch peak)?

Availability (Pacific):
- Tue 2026-11-10: 2:00–3:00pm (works for engineering + compliance)
- Wed 2026-11-11: morning is tight; we could do 3:30–4:30pm but prefer Tue afternoon.

We'll also start filling in the prompt-set-template and send a partial CSV by end of week.

If you can send invites for Tue 2pm PT, include an agenda: 1) infra constraints (30m), 2) SOC2/KMS Q&A (15m), 3) next steps + owners (15m).

Thanks,
Samir
Sr. Product Manager, Healix Health
samir.patel@healix.ai
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@healix.ai>, Luisa Gomez <luisa.gomez@healix.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-07T12:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery notes + propose demo/technical sync and evaluation kickoff

Samir —

Great, Tue 2026-11-10 at 2:00pm PT is confirmed. I've created two calendar items (one combined, and separate follow-up invites):

1) Engineering deep dive + SOC2 KMS Q&A (75 min) — primary: infra + compliance owners
   - Agenda: (a) network & VPC options (15m), (b) KMS/HSM integration + logs (20m), (c) runtime performance & batching (25m), (d) immediate blockers + owners (15m)
   - Invitees: Samir, Luisa, Healix infra lead (please add name/email if different), Redwood: Ben Carter (runtime lead), Stephanie Nguyen, Marissa Cole (success criteria)

2) Evaluation kickoff (30–45 min) — planned for Thu 2026-11-12 or early the following week, TBD during the deep dive

Attachments in this thread: HLX-trial-plan-draft.pdf (we'll iterate this in the kickoff); prompt-set-template.csv (please drop a few representative examples).

Calendars: I attached a calendar-stub (ics) in the invite; if Healix uses a shared resource (conference bridge), we'll include the dial-in in the calendar note.

Ben / Marissa: can you both join the deep dive? Ben, please bring a short perf/throughput slide that addresses Samir's 200 rps ask (ballpark cost impacts + Dedicated vs Hosted routing). Marissa — please prepare a 5-min proposed evaluation charter that maps trial activities to the success metrics Samir listed.

If anyone needs a different time, shout and we'll adjust.

Thanks — sending invites now.

—Stephanie

Attachments referenced: HLX-trial-plan-draft.pdf, prompt-set-template.csv, deep-dive-invite.ics

Thanks, Stephanie — invite accepted.

Quick note from compliance: our lead (Maya Ortiz, maya.ortiz@healix.ai) will join the SOC2/KMS portion only and expects a short list of evidence we should have ready (SOC2 cert, KMS architecture doc, data retention window). I'll upload the partial prompt-set CSV by Friday as discussed.

See you Tue at 2pm PT.
